edit.ability:
Attacks hit 2 creatures of choice at once, and gain 1 point per target struck.
(AAT)(1 point) Heal this creature by 1 HP.
This creature can only be healed from its own ability.
If this creature defeats a prime creature, gain points equal to the star level of that creature.
